turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
You may already say what you do on a normal day, like "I paint on Sundays." Now we move it to the past.
Example: "Today I paint. Yesterday I painted." The action is finished, so I added -ed.
So the rule is: add -ed to a regular verb to say what finished in the past.
Right: He cleaned the car on Sunday. Wrong: He clean the car on Sunday.
Now you try. Write the missing word: "Last night I ___ (call) my friend."
